I tried to make an off-line fp-book copy to read, and the instructions are lacking (outdated, I guess - https://github.com/leanprover/fp-lean/issues/283)
Figured it out in https://github.com/leanprover/fp-lean/pull/284 Can someone merge the latter?

There are also outdated, and different, versions of Lean required to build examples and the book itself, which isn't ideal...
